signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office

bullets: Own product initiatives from discovery through delivery: Investigate problems, define requirements, prioritize solutions, and partner with engineering to launch improvements.…
Understand and improve case execution workflows: Work closely with operations to understand how claims move through federal and state IDR processes. Identify manual steps…
Use data to guide product decisions: Write SQL queries, learn our data models, and conduct your own analysis to understand claim funnel performance, quantify opportunities, and…
Turn complex problems into clear product direction: Distill stakeholder input, operational details, and analytical findings into focused problem statements, actionable…
Prioritize practical, incremental solutions: Break large problems into manageable releases, weigh business impact against effort, and make thoughtful tradeoffs as priorities shift…
Bring structure to messy problems: A lot can go wrong across the IDR process. When something breaks, dig in, size it with numbers, find the root cause, and lay out clear options…
Close the gaps between Ops and product: Learn how Ops works day to day, find where manual work is filling holes in the product, and turn it into product.
Make our decisions smarter: Use models, experiments and LLM evals to improve the offers we make, the IDREs we select and the position statements we submit.
Shape the roadmap: Use what you learn from Ops, the data and our experiments to help decide what we build next and why.
Own initiatives from discovery to launch: Define the problem, write clear requirements, and decide what to build first. After launch, measure whether it worked and keep iterating.
